failure.title: Backend startup imported a type-only PostgresError as a named ESM runtime export
failure.note: The zero-retry client production journey retained its startup report after Node 24 rejected a named PostgresError export that exists in declarations but not in the package ESM module surface.
failure.diagnosis: Vitest module interop allowed the named import during focused tests, but the installed postgres package exposes PostgresError as a property of its default export, so the real production-server loader failed before browser acceptance began.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
